status: implemented workflow map; App remains the composition and cross-feature transaction boundary

workflows.name: application hydration
steps: App effects load app metadata and dataset catalog for datasetRevision
App loads tower inventory; its success sets hydratedDatasetRevision
useProjectWorkspace loads LocalRepository workspace independently and exposes loaded/activeProject
App restorePlanningSnapshot waits for workspaceLoaded, an active Project and non-empty towers, then restores Scenario or draft exactly once per Project ID
App debounced effect waits for restoredProjectRef and matching hydrated/dataset revisions before saveDraft

workflows.name: Run simulation
steps: ControlPanel/WorkflowRail invokes App runSimulation
App validates selected tower, clears surface and begins the rf request channel
requestPayloads.buildSimulationPayload captures the request from selectedTower/settings
Run execution boundary records queued and running SimulationRun snapshots
App simulateForSettings calls /api/analyze-sector and /api/coverage-gaps using the same request signal
App checks request identity, updates simulation/gap output and view metadata, then finishes the Run as succeeded
Run execution boundary persists final Run and associates its exact source snapshot with current result
Run-history persistence failure leaves successful output usable and reports a non-fatal warning
semanticDistinctions: Simulation result remains simulation+coverage gaps; no optimization response is synthesized.
invariants: Simulation request construction, API calls and simulation/coverage-gap result semantics remain in the named App simulation workflow.
Only successful current simulation results replace currentResultRun.

workflows.name: Run optimization
steps: OptimizationGoalsPanel/Run action invokes optimizeAzimuth or optimizeNetwork
App validates optimization constraints and selected cells, begins rf request channel and captures the builder-produced request
Run execution boundary records queued/running OptimizationRun and optimization contract
App calls the distinct optimize endpoint and, for network mode, composes follow-up simulations
App checks request identity and writes optimization-specific output, Pareto/recommendation, comparison and map result state
Run execution boundary captures/persists OptimizationRun response/details and associates the current Run
selectParetoSolution updates the retained optimization Run lifecycle details without changing its execution request
semanticDistinctions: Optimization captures response and optimizer contract; it is not genericized with simulation output.
Network evaluation is a separate non-optimization action and does not create an OptimizationRun.

workflows.name: RF-affecting edit → stale/invalidate
steps: An RF-affecting plan mutation calls invalidatePlanResults before accepting the input edit
invalidatePlanResults cancels rf and dependent analysis request channels
It clears rendered simulation/gap/coverage-surface overlays and dependent network/diagnostic artifacts
It marks planDirty; retained currentResultRun stays as the source identity for stale disclosure
buildResultContext resolves current/stale/historical/unavailable from existing Concept 7G lineage rules
mustInvalidate: optimization constraints when current scoring/result changes
inventory or selected RF source changes

workflows.name: Scenario switch
steps: ScenarioPanel invokes App openSavedScenario
App blocks destructive switch from an unsaved draft and retains the draft
App clears current-result association and focused Run, then calls useProjectWorkspace.activateScenario
App restores the selected Scenario plan/artifacts and updates focused revision/navigation state
result context is rebuilt against the activated Scenario and retained Run identity
owners: App transition guard and restore order
invariants: Historical inspection does not become the current active draft.

workflows.name: Continue from Version
steps: ScenarioPanel invokes App handleContinueFromVersion
App calls useProjectWorkspace.continueFromScenarioRevision
Repository operation creates the mutable draft from the selected historical Version
App restores the new draft, focuses the source revision and marks the plan dirty
invariants: Open source Version is inspection; Continue from Version mutates the working draft.

workflows.name: Apply current or historical optimization solution
steps: Current apply validates currentResultRun is a succeeded OptimizationRun with Scenario/Version lineage; historical apply validates dataset and retained source lineage
Both paths route to applyHistoricalSolution, then useProjectWorkspace.applyHistoricalOptimization and domain applyOptimizationSolution
App invalidates current plan results, restores the returned destination Scenario/Version with requiresRerun, and marks the plan dirty
App reports whether a new Version or branch was created
invariants: Current and historical optimization use one transaction when their semantics match; source Run and public solution identity are preserved.

workflows.name: Historical Run rerun
steps: RunHistoryPanel calls App runAgainFromHistory
App checks active dataset, retained exact request and supported Run type
App replays the historical request; useRunExecution persists the newly captured Run without reusing the old run_id
App replays retained request to the appropriate simulation or optimization endpoint
App captures and persists the new historical Run through useRunExecution.persistRun; it focuses the new historical Run and leaves the current working plan and current-result association unchanged.
invariants: A stale current result reruns the current working plan; a historical Run replays its retained request as a new Run.

workflows.name: Report generation
steps: Current report action asks lazy reportExport to build a report from the live current result/plan; current definition binds source revision when clean and uses live compatibility source when dirty
Historical Run action resolves the exact retained Scenario Version and builds a separate historical report from that Run
Report workflow creates/persists the ReportDefinition through useProjectWorkspace and dynamically builds artifact bytes
useReportArtifacts attempts local retention; failure remains non-fatal and current output is still downloadable/openable
Report view can regenerate from retained source, download stored bytes or delete only the artifact
invariants: Live current plan and historical source Run remain separate actions.
Artifact storage schema and source resolution remain unchanged.

invalidationContract: RF-affecting edits clear rendered outputs and dependent requests, set planDirty, and retain currentResultRun as the stale-source identity. Opening another saved Scenario or selecting/creating/importing a Project clears the current association when the transition is accepted. Dataset switch clears rendered data and sets planDirty while retaining the Run identity. Continue/branch/apply transitions keep source identity as stale lineage while restoring a destination that requires rerun.
